state_space.legal_edits: no-op or one internal sense-codon replacement; terminal stop is fixed

conditional_kernel.phi: linear in four frozen synthetic state features; no biological potency claim

features.codon_order: standard 61 sense codons in lexicographic DNA order

target_endpoint: exact two-step endpoint distribution induced by the frozen oracle weights under the same normalized legal conditional kernel; this preserves state-dependent per-step normalizers
backward: time-specific reverse kernel: step 1 deterministically returns to the unique fixed start; step 2 has an independent trainable logit for every legal reversed edge and is normalized only over parents reachable from that fixed start in one legal step; all other parents are masked

optimization.loss: unweighted mean squared log trajectory-balance residual over all 14641 paths
